title: Eight constrained corrections pass host checks
limits: Both historically and currently refused families have editable constrained alternatives for both paints and native masters.
This demonstrates DSL constructibility, not source reconstruction fidelity, family craft, semantic equivalence, or generation qualification.
Numbers use a rounded ring/counter and upright construction; threed-package uses a six-sided host and explicit seams. Both simplify source curves.
Round 1 removed every error-severity host finding but retained avoidable centring and gap warnings; round 2 fixes those without changing the constrained representation.
The outlined package retains declared off-axis warnings because its source-bound six-sided projection uses non-house diagonal angles.
Every candidate has zero error-severity host findings. Warnings remain visible and are not promoted to acceptance.
Each native-16 candidate is compiled from an explicitly selected 16 master program. Its comparison source is the canonical 24-unit source resampled to 16px, not an independent source optical master.

Only the outlined numbers pair uses distinct coordinate geometry across 16 and 24. The other native-16 programs are separately master-bound renders of the same coordinate bodies and are labeled as such rather than claimed as independent optical constructions.
